extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals, and the general public interested in CSIRO news
extracted.subtask_description: Identifying and describing the different kinds of media-centre outputs an organisation (CSIRO) publishes (media releases, expert commentary, speeches, statements, partner releases) to guide production, submission, or discovery of press materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Official announcements highlighting recent stories and newsworthy information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to publish timely, newsworthy information about the organisation's activities and research. Appears under the Media Centre; intended for distribution to media outlets and public announcement. (Page label: 'Media releases')

rubrics_metrics.name: Expert commentary
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation, interpretations, and opinions from CSIRO experts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides subject-matter perspective, context, and expert opinion rather than being a formal announcement. Useful for journalists seeking expert views and for positioning the organisation on topical issues. (Page label: 'Expert commentary')

rubrics_metrics.name: Speeches
rubrics_metrics.description: Key speeches, thought leadership and presentations from leaders of CSIRO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to publish prepared remarks, thought-leadership pieces and presentations from senior staff; suitable for audience-facing leadership communications and events. (Page label: 'Speeches')

rubrics_metrics.name: Statements
rubrics_metrics.description: More information on our stand and position on specific topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formal statements communicate the organisation's official position on issues or events. Appropriate when clarity of stance is required for stakeholders and media. (Page label: 'Statements')

rubrics_metrics.name: Partner releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Hear about research collaborations from our partners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content originating from partner organisations about collaborative work; useful for amplifying joint announcements and linking partner messaging with the organisation's activities. (Page label: 'Partner releases')

rubrics_metrics.name: General media enquiries / contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: General media enquiries Email / Phone and 'Find the right media contact'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural guidance for media engagement: provides contact details (email, phone) and a mechanism to find appropriate media contacts for specific topics or spokespeople. Important for submitting releases, requesting interviews, or clarifying media-centre procedures. (Page section: 'General media enquiries')

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscribe to news
rubrics_metrics.description: Get the latest in your inbox / Subscribe to our news
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscription mechanism to receive media releases and news updates by email; relevant for distribution/audience-building but not a content-quality criterion. (Page section: 'Subscribe to our news')
